categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Haohan Deep Information Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in network visualization, information security protection, and big data solutions. Its main products include intelligent collection management systems, intelligent application systems, internet information security management systems, and abnormal traffic monitoring and protection systems. The company also develops IoT and vehicle networking systems, providing software and hardware design, product sales, and technical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as large-scale high-speed DPI (Deep Packet Inspection) technology, PB-level big data processing platforms, large-scale network user perception and business quality analysis, large-scale network anomaly traffic and content detection, and virtualization-based cloud security management. It utilizes FPGA chips, ATCA and CLOS hardware architectures, AI, machine learning, and big model technologies. Production mainly involves assembling finished products and programming chips, with PCB boards and electronic components sourced from qualified suppliers and outsourced for assembly.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are telecommunications operators, including the three major Chinese telecom operators, government agencies, and enterprises. The company’s products are widely deployed in backbone, interconnection, provincial networks, and IDC export points. It also serves vertical industries such as finance and media, and is expanding into government and enterprise markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, covering regions including North China, Northeast, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest. It has begun exploring overseas markets with a focus on regions with close geopolitical ties to China such as Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haohan Deep operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the network technology supply chain. It develops and manufactures network visualization and security hardware and software products, providing integrated solutions and services to telecom operators and enterprises. It procures electronic components upstream and assembles finished products downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D investment, focusing on AI, big data, network visualization, network security, and data security. It is developing AI-native applications, deepfake detection, encrypted traffic analysis, and intelligent network scheduling solutions. The firm pursues domestic substitution strategies, collaborates with universities and research institutes, and integrates AI large models into its products to enhance intelligent decision-making and security capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of integrated network visualization and security solutions, software and hardware products, and technical services including data analysis and operation and maintenance support. Sales contracts are obtained via direct sales, bidding, single-source procurement, and business negotiations. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haohan Deep is positioned as a leading domestic provider in network visualization and information security, holding a top market share in DPI equipment among Chinese telecom operators. It competes with both domestic and foreign technology providers but has advantages in technology maturity, product performance, and cost-effectiveness. The company is recognized as a top-tier player with strong R&D and innovation capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 442 million, a 15% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 36.1 million, down 42.6%. R&D investment increased to 25.46% of revenue. Total assets reached about RMB 1.39 billion, with a stable net asset base. The company has a workforce of 662 employees, with 43% in R&D, indicating a strong focus on innovation despite recent revenue decline.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haohan Deep emphasizes its deep technical expertise in DPI and big data analytics, offering high-performance, scalable, and domestically controlled network visualization and security solutions. Its products provide comprehensive traffic identification, anomaly detection, and intelligent scheduling capabilities, enhanced by AI and big model technologies. The company’s solutions support encrypted traffic analysis and deepfake detection, addressing critical security needs and enabling customers to optimize network operations and ensure data security.
